scenarios.name: results
scenarios.note: Results compared with the search check's tolerances: several turns, each side the values are for, every optional output, a rectangular board, and komi and draw value changes that the shared evaluation cache must keep apart.

scenarios.name: priority
scenarios.note: With one analysis thread busy, queued queries start highest priority first. The 19x19 search is stopped once the others are queued.

scenarios.name: terminate
scenarios.note: A queued turn terminated by turn number, then everything; a query after that runs normally.

scenarios.name: during
scenarios.note: Reports during the search: every 0.25 seconds, and once only after 0.02 seconds. Only their form is compared; the final results are compared in full.
